name: Unicode TAG-block concealment whose payload matches no signature
notes: Decode-and-rescan only reaches text a signature recognizes. This frame hides an instruction the catalog has no pattern for, so the presence FLOOR is what catches it: outside an emoji subdivision flag, tag-block characters do not occur in real text, so flagging their presence on retrieved-data carriers costs no FP budget. Warn, not block -- concealment alone is a malice indicator, not a verdict on content.
